review_candidates.title: Country Director - Egypt
review_candidates.description: Egypt Country Director - Egypt Organization Terre des hommes Posted 14 Sep 2026 Closing date 11 Oct 2026 Country Director - Egypt Position Start Date: October 15, 2026 Duration: 24 months Location: Cairo – Egypt Status: family posting Terre des hommes does not set closing dates for this position; recruitment is on-going until the position is filled. Tdh The Terre des hommes Foundation (Tdh), with headquarters in Lausanne and an office in Zurich, is the leading Swiss child rights organisation with more than 2000 employees worldwide. We stand together with children to uphold their rights, protect their lives and improve their well-being. We achieve this through innovative programmes focused on health, migration and access to justice, specially designed to have a positive and sustainable impact. Context Since 1983, Terre des hommes in Egypt works in collaboration with recognized national and local partners to provide support and protection to the most vulnerable children, youth, their families, and their communities. Tdh provides a variety of activities in Greater Cairo and across Upper Egypt governorates, with innovative approaches and sustainable solutions to enhance the resilience and wellbeing of the children and youth and help them to build a better future. The interventions are including mental health and psychosocial support, case management, cash assistance, community mobilization, youth empowerment and capacity building to strengthen protection systems and ensure a protective child-friendly environment. The Children and Youth in Migration sector aims to enhance the wellbeing, resilience, and social inclusion of children and youth affected by migration and displacement by improving their access to essential services, social protection, education, and economic opportunities. It promotes youth empowerment, skills development, and meaningful participation while strengthening the capacities of communities, service providers, and institutions to respond effectively to the needs of mobile and vulnerable populations. Through systems strengthening and livelihood interventions, the programme supports sustainable integration and self-reliance for children, young people, and their families. The Child Protection sector focuses on reducing the social and economic barriers that increase vulnerability and expose children, youth, families, and communities to rights violations, violence, exploitation, abuse, and harmful social norms. It strengthens prevention and response mechanisms, builds protective environments, and reinforces community and institutional protection systems. By establishing effective protection networks and promoting rights-based and inclusive approaches, the programme aims to enhance safety, dignity, and resilience among individuals and communities affected by or at risk of protection concerns. The Access to Justice sector strengthens the capacity of justice and social care systems to address the needs of vulnerable children, youth, and families. It supports access to services within social care and justice institutions, restorative justice approaches, and the reintegration of children in conflict with the law. The programme further advances meaningful child participation in juvenile justice processes, promotes gender justice, and facilitates fair and accessible family law proceedings, contributing to stronger legal protections and improved outcomes for those seeking justice. The health sector is focused on strengthening climate resilience in fragile health systems, ensuring that vulnerable populations maintain access to essential healthcare services despite increasing climate-related shocks and disasters. The initiative aims to retrofit primary healthcare facilities to become climate-resilient, environmentally sustainable, and disaster-ready. By enhancing their capacity to withstand and respond to climate and emergency-related disruptions, these facilities will be able to provide uninterrupted delivery of essential health services during and after crises. Responsibilities He/She ensures the properfunctioning of operations at the national level; as suchhe/she represents the organization in the country. He/She directs and supervises all activities connected to the Tdh projects in his/her assignment country in line with Tdh strategic orientations. He/She represents Tdh (including legally) and promotes the entirety of its remit in the assignment country. He/She demonstrates ethical and exemplary leadership to maintain Tdh good reputation and leads all the Country Office’s collaborators in a shared vision in compliance with Tdh strategic orientations. In collaboration with the programs and expertise, he/she develops the Country Strategy in compliance with the general reference framework. He/She develops and guarantees the implementation of the Country Office’s annual plan of action in compliance with the Country Strategy and internal processes (budgetary management, HR and logistics management, quality and accountability) He/She guarantees the implementation of an operational risk-management system for the Country Office. He/She supervises and supports all staff attached to the Country Office. He/She ensures the Country Office’s internal and external communications. He/She feels accountable to the beneficiaries, collaborators, and donors. He/She makes sure that his/her teams and partners have learned the security policies and the general code of conduct and always comply with them. He/She is responsible for the security of the Tdh teams under his/her responsibility and is in charge of the security rules and the contingency plan of the country under his/her responsibility. He/She manages and assumes ultimate responsibility for the risks and access aspects of the Country Office. More Specifically He/she Has The Following Responsibilities Strategy and steering Representation & external representation Internal coordination Security and safety Human Resources Finance and logistics Business development & Reporting Profile Education : Master’s degree in a relevant field Experience, Skills & Competencies Minimum 8 years’ senior experience in an INGO, managing a large team / operation / programme, including previous experience as Country Director Significant international experience in a humanitarian/refugee/conflict setting Languages : Fluency in English, Arabic an asset IT know-how : Usual MS Office tools Salary Expatriate contract under Swiss regulations between CHF 5’000.- and CHF 5’700.- Gross/month according to experience x 13 times, Paid leaves: 25 days annual leaves local accommodation and transportation, Health insurance, accident and medical repatriation insurance, return flight. Tdh Global Code of Conduct and Risk Management Policies : Fully complies with Tdh’s Global Code of Conduct and systematically reports any breach to the Code through the whistleblowing procedure: raises awareness within the Foundation on abuse and violence and the rights deriving therefrom, respecting the rights and dignity of children, members of the communities and our own Staff Commits to respecting Risk Management Policies including: Safeguarding Policies (Child Safeguarding Policy, Policy on the Protection against Sexual Exploitation and the Directive on Staff Misconduct at the Workplace), Safety and Security Policy and Anti-Fraud/Corruption and Prevention of the Financing of Criminal Activities Policies Commits to reducing the risk of abuse and harm by developing a culture of open and informed leadership within the organization and in our work with children and the communities in which we intervene in. We offer an exciting and varied work, useful and meaningful, in a team that wants to make a difference for vulnerable children. Are you interested? Do you want to face this challenge? How to apply Please applying directly online: https://jobs.tdh.org/en-GB/jobs/8369397-country-director-egypt?promotion=2193345-trackable-share-link-reliefweb Application files sent through our official website will be processed only if complete (CV + cover letter). Additional documents (diplomas, work certificates, etc.) will be requested at a later stage. We will be in touch with the shortlisted candidates only in the selection process – with the large number of applications received, we unfortunately cannot provide personal follow-up to the larger candidate pool. Thanks for your understanding. For any questions you can consult the FAQ below the job advertisements. review_candidates.description: Cost Control Engineer – Saudi National Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia Salary: Up to SAR 12,600 per month The Opportunity TalentHive is partnering exclusively with a well-established and diversified Saudi group as it continues a significant transformation and Saudization programme across its businesses. As part of the continued strengthening of its PMO and cost-control capability , we are looking for an experienced Saudi Cost Control Engineer to join the organisation in Dammam. This is an opportunity to join a large, operationally diverse business and play an important role in strengthening cost visibility, budgeting, forecasting and financial control across projects and operations . Key Responsibilities As Cost Control Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting effective cost planning, monitoring and control, including: Monitor actual expenditure and commitments against approved budgets Support the preparation of budgets, forecasts and cost plans Track project and operational costs and identify variances, trends and potential overruns Perform detailed cost and variance analysis Prepare regular cost-control reports and management information Support forecasting and provide visibility of expected financial performance Maintain accurate cost information within relevant systems and reporting tools Work closely with PMO, Finance and operational stakeholders Support improvements to cost-control processes, reporting and governance What We’re Looking For Saudi National Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Quantity Surveying or Construction Management 5+ years of experience in Cost Control, Cost Engineering, Project Cost Management or a closely related area Proven hands-on experience in budgeting, cost tracking and variance analysis Strong knowledge of cost-control systems, tools and reporting methodologies Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret cost data and identify performance issues Experience within a PMO or multi-project environment would be advantageous Professional certifications such as CCP, PMP or a similar cost-management qualification are preferred but not essential Why Consider This Opportunity? You’ll be joining a major Saudi organisation with diverse operations at an important stage of its transformation and continued investment in Saudi professional talent. The role provides exposure to a complex operating environment and the opportunity to contribute directly to stronger cost-control, planning and performance-management practices , while developing your career within an evolving PMO function. Salary: Up to SAR 12,600 per month Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia If you are a Saudi Cost Control professional with strong hands-on experience across budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking and variance analysis , we would be interested in hearing from you. Apply with your CV for consideration. Applications are open to Saudi Nationals in line with the requirements of the programme.

Nous concevons et exploitons des infrastructures et bâtiments intelligents qui répondent aux défis liés à l’urgence climatique et permettent un aménagement du territoire plus équilibré, durable et résilient. Nos 20 500 employés opèrent dans plus de 100 pays, mettant à profit leur expertise pour développer et fournir des innovations et des solutions de pointe à nos clients. Par la diversité de nos domaines d’intervention, nous sommes un acteur clé de l’organisation collective de la société et du cadre de vie des citoyens dans le monde entier. La Direction Afrique, basée à Casablanca au Maroc, regroupe 380 collaborateurs et agit sur l’ensemble du continent au travers d’une 15e d’implantations locales. Elle est chargée de coordonner l’activité des différents métiers du groupe sur la région Afrique et d’assurer une cohérence géographique de la stratégie et du développement du Groupe. Description du poste Expert Technique Travaux Voie Ferrée, chargé de la construction de la LGV de KENITRA à MARRAKECH. Vos activités comprendront, mais sans s'y limiter : Contrôle technique spécialisé : · Vérifier la conformité des travaux de pose de la voie (rails, traverses, ballast, libération, géométrie). · Inspecter la mise en œuvre des appareils de voie (aiguillages, cœurs mobiles, incorporation). · Participer aux essais et réceptions d’ouvrages (contrôle de la géométrie, essais dynamiques, etc...). · Rédiger des rapports de contrôle, signaler les non-conformités et suivre leur résolution. Suivi qualité et sécurité : · Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité ferroviaire sur les chantiers. · S’assurer de la conformité aux STI et normes. · Participer à l’élaboration des dossiers de sécurité. · Participer à l’élaboration des dossiers d’homologation. · Proposer des actions correctives et d’amélioration. Assistance à la Maîtrise d’Ouvrage : · Apporter un appui technique dans le Kext des EXE et procédures travaux. · Participer aux réunions techniques et de coordination. · Suivre l’avancement des travaux et alerter sur les risques ou dérives. Qualifications Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur en génie civil ou mécanique, ou diplôme universitaire équivalent) avec une expérience minimum de 20 ans dans le domaine de la voie ferrée LGV. Maîtrise des techniques de pose et d’entretien de la voie ferrée et des appareils de voie. Connaissance des normes ferroviaires et des procédures de contrôle. Capacité à rédiger des rapports techniques et à dialoguer avec les parties prenantes. Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’analyse, sens du travail en équipe. La connaissance des référentiels LGV et/ou STI est indispensable pour la bonne réussite de la mission. La maîtrise du français est indispensable.

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual. Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant. About The business unit The Energy unit delivers services to clients globally across several sectors including hydropower, nuclear, waste, renewable generation and transmission & distribution networks. Together we provide integrated engineering and project management services across the project lifecycle – from concept and design to construction and operations, to decommissioning or repowering and life extension. Together with our clients, we’re helping to deliver the energy transition globally. Overview Of The Role We are looking for Civil & Structural (C&S) Engineers to strengthen the existing Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) team; providing design capabilities across a variety of project types and technologies, supporting our clients across the world as part of the energy transition. You will work with our team of engineers, technicians and draftsmen to deliver our work to specified standards and project schedule, while following our project governance. As part of your day-to-day work, you will be asked for analyse project documents, design of concrete structures including bar bending schedule checks, design steel structures including connection details, 3D model review under supervision of senior Engineer Staff. You are expected to deliver projects in accordance with the applicable Codes & Standard, prepare input for draftsmen and/or 3d modeller, examine, mark-up and align documentation and drawings. The ideal candidate would have good understanding of steel and/or concrete design and a good familiarity with main national and international codes (Eurocodes and American codes). An understanding of power generation plants would be a plus, but not a necessity. Currently we are developing projects in Thermal, & Nuclear sectors, Gas & Liquid, Wind and Solar, BESS, hydropower and our involvement is also in other sectors like Metros (UK & Canada), railways (UK), etc. providing a wide range of services to owners, contractors and developers, including feasibility, planning, detailed design, owner’s engineering and site supervision. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate and take positive steps to create an inclusive culture. Candidate specification A MSc degree in Civil Structural Engineering is mandatory Ability to adapt and work on multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic and fast-paced environment Experience of working with structural design software packages (e.g. Staad, Sap2000, GT Strudl, Idea Statica) Knowledge of Tekla structure, Revit and Civil 3D software would be a plus Good understanding of the design process and ability to demonstrate working knowledge of brief/scope documents, design concepts as well as experienced in producing calculations As the majority of our deliverables are in English, a good level of oral and written English is expected, with Italian and any other languages being a plus Equality, diversity, and inclusion We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute. Accessibility We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you. Agile working At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust. We offer some fantastic benefits including: Competitive annual leave Private medical insurance Continuous development opportunities – because we want you to thrive Annual bonus scheme - subject to Company performance Wellbeing support including access to an independent Employer Assistance Scheme, wellbeing champions and access to learning and support resources The opportunity to make a difference; learn more about our social outcomes Apply now, or for more information about our application process, click here. review_candidates.title: Channel Manager - Southern Europe/Northern Africa/Brazil
review_candidates.description: DNA Genotek, a part of OraSure Technologies Inc (OTI), develops products that optimize ease of collection and provide superior samples. DNA provides proven performance for those requiring high-quality biological samples for nucleic acid testing. Our ability to positively affect change is powered by the innovative tools and diagnostics we deliver to the market. Together with its wholly owned subsidiaries, OTI provides its customers with end-to-end solutions. It’s first-to-market, innovative products include rapid tests for the detection of antibodies to HIV and Hepatitis C (HCV) on the OraQuick® platform; sample self-collection and stabilization products for molecular applications; and oral fluid laboratory tests for detecting various drugs of abuse. Overview DNA Genotek products are marketed worldwide and support thousands of customers as they achieve breakthroughs in genomic and microbiome research, in diagnostics laboratories, in the pharmaceutical industry, in companion animal genomics and in personalized medicine. This job posting is to hire for an existing vacancy. The Channel Manager is responsible for expanding and managing the company’s international distributor network outside of North America. This role focuses on identifying strategic markets, onboarding new distribution partners, and driving performance through ongoing support and accountability. The ideal candidate will have strong commercial acumen, experience in international channel management, and a deep understanding of Life Sciences or molecular diagnostics industry. Snapshot of Responsibilities: Market Assessment & Strategy Development Evaluate global markets to identify countries where distribution partnerships align with business goals and regulatory feasibility Develop market entry strategies and prioritize regions based on commercial potential, competitive landscape, and product fit Territory is Southern Europe, Northern Africa and Brazil Distributor Identification & Contracting Source and assess potential distribution partners based on capabilities, market reach, and strategic alignment Lead contract negotiations and finalize agreements in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and Regulatory teams Distributor Onboarding & Enablement Develop and deliver comprehensive onboarding programs, including product training, sales enablement, and marketing support Serve as the primary point of contact for distributor inquiries and ongoing relationship management Performance Management & Accountability Set clear sales targets and performance expectations for each distributor Monitor progress through regular business reviews, pipeline tracking, and forecasting Implement corrective actions or support plans where performance gaps are identified What you bring: 5+ years of experience in international sales, channel management, or business development within the Life Sciences or medical device industry Minimum Bachelor of Science Degree or equivalent combination of relevant job experience and training Proven success in identifying and managing distributor relationships across diverse geographies Strong negotiation skills and experience with international contracting Exceptional communication skills, including oral, written, and presentation abilities Ability to work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders including Legal, Regulatory, Marketing, and Product teams Comfortable working independently and managing multiple time zones and cultures Willingness to travel internationally (up to 50%) The base salary range for this full-time position is 53,000 to 80,000 (in local currency). In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for our Sales Compensation Plan with an annual target of 40,000 (in local currency). The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base salary for the position, based on our defined salary pay ranges. Our ranges are broad to account for differences in roles, performance, experience, skillsets, education and business needs and individual pay is determined by a variety of factors. OTI encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of the communities in which we operate.
